# SpeedyIndex MCP

> Unofficial Bun/TypeScript stdio MCP server. Only get_balance is implemented; the other 11 tools are roadmap work. No npm release is published.

- [README](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/README.md): Setup and tool contract
- [Architecture](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Runtime boundaries
- [Dependencies](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/docs/dependencies.md): Version decisions
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/docs/implementation-plan.md): Unimplemented scope
- [Contributing](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development and review
- [Security](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Private reporting
- [Agent contract](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository instructions
